text:
Maria: Heads up — planning a microthread push for the webinar next Weds (Apr 28). Need: X thread (5 tweets), LinkedIn post, and a 30s clip. Can we lock creative + GIF hero by Tue EOD? :calendar:

Kai: I can do GIF. Prefer 800x420, looped. Do we want text overlays? branding lockup?

Maria: Keep overlays minimal — 1-line hook + CTA. Use Redwood logo top-left. CTA: "Register" with UTM params (see below). Alt text required for accessibility.

Sasha: Landing page: https://redwood.ai/webinar-optimize-inference?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr28
  Please use that full URL for CTAs. Also add hidden field: source=marketing_x_thread

Jon: Draft for X thread — propose 5 tweets (hook -> problem -> data point -> quick fix -> CTA). Roughly:
```
1/ Hook: Latency kills product adoption. We fixed it for a finance app — 3x lower 99th pct.
2/ Problem: When models are served poorly, users drop off. Cost spikes.
3/ Data: With batching + prefix cache we cut tokens/req by 35% in prod.
4/ Fix: How we did it (short bulleted): config, quantization, smart routing.
5/ CTA: Join our webinar Apr 28 — register: https://redwood.ai/webinar-optimize-inference?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar_apr28
```

Sam: Quick ask: can we include a line about post-demo followup? e.g., "Attend for early access to a Dedicated trial" — that helps inbound routing.

Maria: Yes. Add: "Attend for early access to a Dedicated trial" as part of the CTA. Keep it short.

Ops-bot: heads-up: webhook created -> HubSpot list: Webinar_Apr28; zap -> #sales-webinar. Registrants will be tagged with source=marketing_x_thread.

Sasha: Routing note for Sales: please prioritize registrants from X thread during first 48h. Use sequence template: "Webinar registrant - quick intro" (S1: 4h after reg, S2: 48h).

Kai: GIF options attached: 3 comps (fast loop, brand fade, no-text). Which preference?

Maria: Preference = brand fade (no-text). Kai, can you export 800x420 mp4 + GIF and include accessible alt text?

Kai: Yep — will drop assets in /marketing/assets/webinar-apr28 by Tue 5pm. Alt text draft: "Animation showing decreasing latency graph overlayed with Redwood logo — call to action: register for webinar". Adjust wording if needed.

Emma: I'll monitor X engagement for first 3 hours and capture top replies for feed to SDRs. Also: can someone own first 30 mins of replies? I can do hours 0–1.

Jon: I can cover 1–2pm PT. Emma will do 0–1 — perfect.

Sam: For LinkedIn post — shorter narrative, one image, CTA to same landing. Sam will post and tag design.

Maria: Final checklist:
- Creative (Kai) by Tue EOD
- Landing page + webhook (Ops-bot) ✅
- X thread copy (Jon) draft by Mon noon
- LinkedIn copy (Sam) by Tue noon
- Monitoring rota (Emma/Jon) set

Maria: Anything else? :rocket:

Sasha: Please add UTM param utm_content=gif_v1 when we push the GIF version so we can A/B the static image vs GIF in GA.

Maria: Great call — update landing CTAs accordingly. Thanks team, will loop back with a final post schedule tomorrow. :thumbsup:
